name: DeskcommCRM
description: Open-source AI sales OS — self-hosted CRM with native AI agents + WhatsApp (WAHA). Open alternative to Kommo, Octadesk & Intercom for any business that sells by chat. MCP-ready, multi-tenant, LGPD.
one_liner: A self-hosted CRM where AI agents chat with your customers on WhatsApp, qualify leads, and help close sales — you run it on your own server instead of paying a monthly SaaS fee.
buyer: A small business owner in Latin America (or anywhere WhatsApp is the primary sales channel) who currently loses leads because no one can respond to WhatsApp messages fast enough.
business_use_cases: A real-estate agency deploys it so an AI agent handles the first round of WhatsApp inquiries about listings overnight and on weekends, only escalating hot leads to a human.
A local clinic or salon uses it to auto-confirm appointments and answer FAQ questions over WhatsApp without hiring a receptionist.
A regional e-commerce seller runs it to recover abandoned-cart conversations by chatting with customers directly in WhatsApp.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a done-for-you managed-hosting package (the install kit already targets one VPS provider) with monthly support.
Charge a one-time setup + WhatsApp integration fee for small businesses that don't want to self-host.
Take an affiliate cut from the VPS hosting partnership already built into the install script.

steal_this: Set up the one-command installer for three local WhatsApp-heavy businesses (salon, clinic, small shop) this weekend and charge a flat setup fee — the installer already does the hard part.
